en.title: How to play "Infinity Maze"
en.footer: If you have any questions, contact support: cameoshell09@gmail.com
ios: Tap the screen in the direction you want the hero to move.
Choose Rectangular, Hexagonal, or Honeycomb maze types from the game menu.
Hexagonal and Honeycomb mazes support six directions; tap diagonally to move along diagonal paths.
Tap Start Over to start a new game.
Use Easy, Medium, Hard, or Insane levels, worth 5, 15, 45, and 100 points.
Pro unlocks every hero and doubles Maze Coin rewards. Leaderboard scores stay fair.
Use Print when you want a hard copy of the current maze.
mac: Click in the game window, or use arrow keys, to move in the corresponding direction.
Choose Rectangular, Hexagonal, or Honeycomb maze types from the maze type menu.
Hexagonal and Honeycomb mazes support six directions; click or use supported controls toward the diagonal path.
Click Start Over to start a new game.
Use Easy, Medium, Hard, or Insane levels, worth 5, 15, 45, and 100 points.
Pro unlocks every hero and doubles Maze Coin rewards. Leaderboard scores stay fair.
Use Print when you want a hard copy of the current maze.
tvos: Swipe on the Remote Clickpad to move in the nearest maze direction.
Hexagonal and Honeycomb mazes support six-direction movement by swiping diagonally.
The Remote arrow buttons are shortcuts for the main four directions.
Press Play/Pause on the Remote to open Settings.
Double tap the Clickpad on the Remote to open Game Center.
Use Easy, Medium, Hard, or Insane levels, worth 5, 15, 45, and 100 points.
Pro unlocks every hero and doubles Maze Coin rewards. Leaderboard scores stay fair.

点击“Start Over”开始新游戏。
Easy、Medium、Hard 和 Insane 难度分别对应 5、15、45、100 分。
Pro 解锁全部英雄并提供双倍迷宫币奖励；排行榜得分保持公平。
如需当前迷宫的纸质版本，可使用 Print。

六边形和蜂巢迷宫可通过斜向滑动支持六方向移动。
遥控器方向键是四个主要方向的快捷操作。
按下遥控器的播放/暂停键打开设置。
双击遥控器点按板打开 Game Center。

en.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Introduction
This Privacy Policy explains how Infinity Maze handles information when you use the app or visit this website. By using the app or website, you accept this policy.
Contact
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact support: cameoshell09@gmail.com
User accounts
Infinity Maze does not require you to create an account or provide personal information.
Personal information
Infinity Maze does not collect personal information such as your name or email address. We do not collect keystrokes or other unrelated device data.
Data stored on device
